conclusion: All 5 angles searched; every high-relevance finding traced back to an already-staged/applied hypothesis or existing wiki page via targeted grep dedup (not just keyword overlap) -- this project's hypothesis pipeline (H001-H494+) has now absorbed nearly all directly-actionable recent literature across pairs-trading/LLM, PEAD-text, cross-sectional momentum, and multi-agent-trading angles; searches on these well-trodden angles are increasingly returning the project's own prior work rather than new ground.
